mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level directly increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship is consistently negative across historical data.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of observations when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and SPX returns falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that suppresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310) indicate an overheating economy, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 310, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle defined by rising FEDFUNDS and elevated CPIAUCSL, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to heightened expectations of prolonged high interest rates and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the regime condition, or the return difference between the regime and non-regime periods is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) reflects a tight labor market that supports strong corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of observations when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and SPX returns falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 102.0, it signals robust economic activity that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 102.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and SPX returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1300.0) indicates strong consumer demand and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of observations when HOUST > 1300.0, or the Rank IC between HOUST and SPX returns falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceed 700,000 million dollars, it reflects robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC between RSAFS and SPX returns is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
